title: Statement pin
description: The human-owned two-level statement pin (TOML, D43/F10): `statement` is a hard pin (CI fails on a mismatch until the owner re-approves), `digest` only marks dependent reviews stale. Workers never edit it.

statement.description: Required: the approved statement fingerprint (hard: a mismatch fails).

digest.description: Optional: the transitive digest at approval (a mismatch only marks the entry stale); empty means unset.

evidence.description: Optional: the fingerprint record holding the same statement fingerprint; empty means unset.

approved.description: Written by the owner: `YYYY-MM-DD <initials>`. The kit never reads it; empty until approved.

attestation.description: Written by the owner: the id of the attestation holding the approval's scope wording; empty means none. A non-empty id must exist.

decl.description: An absolute Lean declaration id as `Name.toString` prints it (the ids `tracker graph` uses).

fingerprintId.description: Evidence id of a fingerprint record: `fingerprint:<decl>@<s12>.<d12>`, the first 12 hex digits of the statement fingerprint and of the digest.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 hash: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.
